verses.text: Paul, prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our dear fellow worker,
and to Apphia wey we love, and Archippus our fellow soldier, and to di church wey dey your house:
Grace and peace from God our Papa and Lord Jesus Christ dey with una.
I dey always thank my God, as I dey remember you for my prayer dem,
as I hear about your love, and di faith wey you get for Lord Jesus and for all di holy people;
I pray make di fellowship of your faith work well, as you dey know every good thing wey dey inside us for Christ.
Because I get plenty joy and comfort from your love, brother, because you don refresh di heart of di holy people.
So even though I get all boldness inside Christ to command you wetin suppose be,
I prefer to beg you because of love, as I be Paul, old man, and now prisoner of Christ Jesus too.
I dey beg you for my pikin Onesimus, wey I don become im papa for my chain,
wey before no dey useful to you, but now e dey useful to you and to me.
I don send am back to you. So receive am, na my own heart.
I wan keep am with me, so that e go serve me for your place as I dey chain for di Good News.
But I no want do anything without your agreement, so that di good wey you go do no go be by force, but by your own free will.
Maybe na why e leave you for small time, so that you go get am forever,
no more as servant, but pass servant, as dear brother, especially to me, but how much more to you, both for flesh and for Lord.
So if you count me as partner, receive am as you go receive me.
But if e don wrong you at all, or if e owe you anything, put am for my account.
Na me, Paul, write dis with my own hand: I go pay am back. I no go talk say you owe me your own life too.
Yes, brother, make I get joy from you for Lord. Refresh my heart for Christ.
As I get confidence for your obedience, I write to you, as I know say you go do even pass wetin I talk.
But prepare place for me to stay too, because I hope say through una prayer dem, God go return me to una.
Epaphras, my fellow prisoner for Christ Jesus, dey greet you,
and Mark, Aristarchus, Demas and Luke, my fellow workers, dey greet you too.
Di grace of our Lord Jesus Christ dey with una spirit. Amen.
